Spells:
Barkskin (D2 Tran): Gives touched a +3 natural armor enhancement bonus to Armor Class for 70 min
Call Lightning (D3 Evoc): R170' 1 bolt per rd inflicts 3d6 HP electricity, or 3d10 HP during a storm, (save Reflex DC 17 half) for 7 bolts within 7 min
Create Water (D0 Conj): R40' Creates 14 gallons of pure water; any that remains after 24 hr disappears
Detect Magic (D0 Divi): 60' cone reveals the presence and power of magical auras and allows making Knowledge (Arcana) checks to determine their schools for concentration up to 7 min
Entangle (D1 Tran): R680' Causes vegetation in a 40' radius to entangle creatures (save Reflex DC 15 negates; Strength or Escape Artist breaks an entanglement) for 7 min
Flaming Sphere (D2 Evoc): R170' 5' diameter sphere inflicts 3d6 HP fire (save Reflex DC 16 negates) for 7 rd; can be directed to jump 30' and move 30' per rd
Flare (D0 Evoc): R40' Dazzles the target (save Fortitude DC 14 negates) for 1 min
Gust Of Wind (D2 Evoc): Creates a 60' line of wind for 1 rd that moves objects, extinguishes unprotected flames, knocks down Small and smaller creatures, and halts Medium ones (save Fortitude negates; a successful DC 15 Strength check allows Medium creatures to move); Tiny creatures are also pushed 1d4x10', suffering 1d4 HP nonlethal per 10'; flying creatures suffer a -4 penalty on Fly checks and require a DC 20 Fly check to move against the wind, with Tiny flying creatures blown back 2d6x10', suffering 2d6 HP nonlethal (save Fly DC 25 negates)
Ice Storm (D4 Evoc): R680' Hail in a 20' radius, 40' high cylinder inflicts 3d6 HP bludgeoning and 2d6 HP cold for 1 rd, then -4 Perception and difficult terrain for 7 rd
Jump (D1 Tran): Gives touched +20 Acrobatics to jumps (save Will DC 15 negates) for 7 min
Light (D0 Evoc): Touched object emits a 20' normal light for 70 min
Magic Stone (D1 Tran): Enhances 3 touched stones (save Will DC 15 negates) to attack at +1 and inflict 1d6+1 HP, or 2d6+2 HP vs. undead, within 30 min
Pass Without Trace (D1 Tran): Causes 7 touched to leave no tracks or scent (save Will DC 15 negates) for 7 hr
Poison (D3 Necr): Touched suffers 1d3 points of Constitution damage each rd (save Fortitude DC 17 ends) for 6 rd
Read Magic (D0 Divi): Allows self to read magical writing and identify Glyphs and Symbols with a successful DC 10 + spell level Spellcraft check for 70 min
Resist Energy (D2 Abju): Gives touched resistance 20 to a choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic (save Fortitude DC 16 negates) for 70 min
Sleet Storm (D3 Conj): R680' 40' radius, 20' high cylinder blocks sight, extinguishes small fires, and requires a DC 10 Acrobatics check to move at half Speed (failure by 5 or more causes a fall) for 7 rd
Speak With Animals (D1 Divi): Allows self to converse with animals for 7 min
Spider Climb (D2 Tran): Gives touched a 20' climb Speed, the ability to climb walls and ceilings, and a +8 bonus to Climb checks (save Will DC 16 negates), for 70 min; the target also retains its Dexterity bonus to Armor Class while climbing
Stabilize (D0 Conj): R40' Stabilizes a target with negative hit points (save Will DC 14 negates)
Summon Nature's Ally I (D1 Conj): R40' Summons a 1st-level creature that fights foes and obeys orders for 7 rd
Summon Nature's Ally IV (D4 Conj): R40' Summons 1 4th-level, 1d3 3rd-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 7 rd

Cure Light Wounds Potion (D1 Conj): (2) Touched regains 1d8+1 hit points (save Will DC 11 negates); undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will DC 11 half)
Cure Moderate Wounds Potion (D3 Conj): (3) Touched regains 2d8+5 hit points (save Will DC 14 negates); undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will DC 14 half)
Cure Serious Wounds Potion (Adept3 Conj): Touched regains 3d8+8 hit points (save Will DC 14 negates); undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will DC 14 half)

Calm Animals (D1 Ench): (2) R25' Makes 2d4+1 HD of animals of the same kind in a 15' radius docile (save Will DC 11 negates) for 1 min
Magic Fang (D1 Tran): Gives touched +1 attacks and damage when using a specified natural weapon (save Will DC 11 negates) for 1 min
Magic Stone (D1 Tran): Enhances 3 touched stones (save Will DC 11 negates) to attack at +1 and inflict 1d6+1 HP, or 2d6+2 HP vs. undead, within 30 min
Message (S0 Tran): (2) R110' Allows self to exchange whispered messages with 1 target for 10 min; messages can circumvent barriers, but 1' of stone, 1" of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3' of wood or dirt blocks the spell
Obscuring Mist (D1 Conj): (2) Creates a 20'-radius, 20' high cylinder fog that obscures vision, giving a 20% miss chance on attacks within 5' and a 50% chance on more distant attacks, for 1 min
Produce Flame (D1 Evoc): Creates a torch flame in self hand for 1 min; it can be used repeatedly for melee touch or R120' ranged touch attacks that inflict 1d6+1 HP fire, reducing the remaining duration by 1 min each time
Shillelagh (D1 Tran): (2) Touched small, medium, or large staff gains +1 attacks and inflicts 1d8+1 HP, 2d6+1 HP, or 3d6+1 HP (save Will DC 11 negates) when wielded by self for 1 min
Shocking Grasp (S1 Evoc): Melee touch attack (+3 vs. metal) inflicts 1d6 HP electricity
